{
  "schema_version": 1,
  "kind": "knowledge_card",
  "id": "doc:ve-race",
  "service": "venv",
  "revision": "1",
  "title": "Unsafe paths and changing environment snapshots",
  "summary": "An environment may change during package installation or replacement. Symlinked metadata and changed cfg or distribution inventories prevent a stable static snapshot and must preserve uncertainty.",
  "tags": [
    "venv_metadata_unsafe_path",
    "venv_metadata_changed",
    "venv_metadata_not_regular",
    "venv_metadata_budget"
  ],
  "checks": [
    "Repeat after installation/replacement activity has finished and approve every external base path explicitly.",
    "Keep venv instance identity and deployment timing scoped to the application process under investigation."
  ],
  "limitations": "Reads reject metadata symlinks and nonregular files; there is no filesystem-wide atomic snapshot guarantee.",
  "applicability": "POSIX CPython venv metadata for Python 3.11-3.14; static evidence only",
  "source": {
    "url": "https://packaging.python.org/en/latest/specifications/recording-installed-packages/",
    "documentation_version": "Python 3.14 and current PyPA specifications",
    "verified_at": "2026-10-02",
    "licence": "original project summary; official documentation referenced, not copied"
  },
  "integrity": "abe35da5120dc04634ab2a8d4842a90f8d9bfa79591e9f84e9321e784e18cbd1"
}

{
  "schema_version": 1,
  "kind": "knowledge_card",
  "id": "doc:ve-runtime",
  "service": "venv",
  "revision": "1",
  "title": "Interpreter, imports and native dependency boundaries",
  "summary": "A process interpreter prefix, import path and loaded modules determine actual runtime environment. Static package metadata cannot prove native extension ABI, loader libraries, import-name mapping or which environment an existing service uses.",
  "tags": [
    "venv_layout",
    "venv_dependencies",
    "runtime",
    "abi",
    "imports",
    "process"
  ],
  "checks": [
    "Correlate trusted application instrumentation for process interpreter identity and an authoritative functional oracle.",
    "Check OS library and architecture compatibility through a separately approved read-only collector."
  ],
  "limitations": "No target-controlled Python, pip, modules or entry points are executed; runtime behavior remains unmeasured.",
  "applicability": "POSIX CPython venv metadata for Python 3.11-3.14; static evidence only",
  "source": {
    "url": "https://docs.python.org/3.14/library/sys.html",
    "documentation_version": "Python 3.14 and current PyPA specifications",
    "verified_at": "2026-10-02",
    "licence": "original project summary; official documentation referenced, not copied"
  },
  "integrity": "87f28f6eea8f1465137ea37769bb461fed15461c763027161ef8cc78148b2a06"
}
